messages:
Maya: Heads up — planning a staggered rollforward for model-serving v2.3.1 tonight at 22:00 PT. It's a config-only change (batching/window tweak). Intend to run canary -> ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 15m waits. Regions: us-west1, us-east1, eu-west1. Who can own the wedge/smoke? Ping @Diego @Sam

Diego: I can take the wedge and smoke ownership. Will be on call from 21:30 PT. What's the smoke checklist?

Maya: Thanks — basic smoke: successful deploy, healthcheck OK, p50 latency within 10% of baseline, error-rate < 0.5% on the canary traffic. Also validate KV-cache hit rates for hot prefixes.

Sam: I'll run a quick perf test on the staging cluster at 20:30 PT and post baseline numbers. Will also validate batch sizing to ensure no latency spike.

Priya: FYI automated canary monitors are configured in alerts.yaml. Thresholds match Maya's numbers except we have a secondary alert for tail latency (p95 > 2x baseline).

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: v2.3.1 -> production | start=1890160800 (22:00 PT) | policy=staggered | steps=[1,5,20,100] | step_interval=900s | regions=[us-west1,us-east1,eu-west1]

Evelyn: Quick Q — cohort selection: do we want to prefer low-traffic customer slices for first two steps, or just do uniform sample? Suggest low-traffic to minimize impact.

Maya: Good call. Let's do targeted low-traffic cohorts for 1% and 5% (customer-tag: stage=alpha or traffic<50rps). 20% can be uniform by region. I'll update rollout policy.

Diego: Rollback plan: immediate rollback to v2.3.0 if error-rate spike > 0.5% OR p50 latency regression > 25% sustained for 2 intervals. I'll hold the rollback command and coordinate with Maya.

Sam: Staging perf at 20:35: p50=82ms, p95=210ms, error-rate=0.02%. Batch sizes stable. I'll attach flamegraphs in the release thread (link coming).

Priya: Alerts: I've set automated pause on ramp if any critical alerts fire. If paused, manual resume required from the release owner. Also enable live trace sampling for first 30m of each step.

Maya: Perfect. Owners: Diego (wedge + rollback), Sam (staging perf validation), Priya (alerts + monitoring), Evelyn (cohort selection). I'll start the rollout and stand by 22:00 PT. Callout: if anything looks off please @channel and escalate to the oncall. :thumbsup:
